name: Ansible MCP Server for Cisco Secure Firewall
shortDescription: MCP server that lets an AI agent run reviewed cisco.fmcansible playbooks against FMC, with an allowlist, dry run, and confirmation gate.
description: The agent never writes automation. It selects from an allowlist of playbooks a human already reviewed and merged, and supplies variables drawn from a fixed permitted set. Every invocation is a fixed argv with shell=False; the playbook path is resolved and re-verified inside ansible/playbooks; extra variables are written to a temporary JSON file rather than interpolated into a command line; credential and connection variables are refused outright and come only from the operator's environment. Real execution is disabled until ANSIBLE_MCP_ALLOW_RUN=true and additionally requires a confirmation token bound to the dry-run plan.

tools.name: list_playbooks
tools.description: Allowlisted playbooks and whether each mutates configuration.

tools.name: dry_run_playbook
tools.description: --check --diff; reports would-change tasks and issues a token.

tools.name: run_playbook_for_real
tools.description: Real execution. Gated by ANSIBLE_MCP_ALLOW_RUN and a plan-bound token.

safety.confirmationBinding: HMAC over canonical plan JSON (playbook + extra_vars + would_change), per-process key, 600s TTL

thirdParty.relationship: Invoked via the standard ansible-playbook interface. Not vendored, copied, or linked.

support: Community, best effort. Not supported by Cisco TAC.
